metadata.title: Royal Rainmaking Department official rain-radar station roster
metadata.note: This is an official station/mission page, not a procurement or payment register. The CAPPI publication view may contain a different currently exposed subset.
metadata.historical_snapshot_note: The 2564 knowledge page listed 10 stations (5 fixed S-band and 5 mobile C-band), with Rong Khwang listed as mobile and without Hat Yai; the current station page lists 12 stations, with Rong Khwang fixed and Hat Yai fixed, and Pluak Daeng mobile. This documents a roster difference over time, but does not by itself establish when or why any station was reclassified or replaced.

historical_snapshots.review_note: The page gives operational/educational information, not a procurement record. It should be compared with the signed Rong Khwang S-band contract and later asset register.
